label: allin_2025_predictions_2025jan
source: All-In Podcast — 2025 predictions (bestie guest Gavin Baker)
host: Jason Calacanis, Chamath, David Sacks, David Friedberg (Gavin Baker panelist)

results.summary: Big businesses that use AI thoughtfully will be the primary winners in the near term due to test-time compute advantages
results.quote: if you're a big business and you can pay a million dollars to let an AI think for 6 weeks

results.summary: Waymo is a major potential deal target or IPO candidate in 2025 given rapid market share gains
results.quote: waymo is now a 22% market share of rides in SF which is the same as Lyft

results.summary: America could print 5%+ real GDP growth at some point in the next four years due to AI productivity and deregulation
results.quote: America will print at least one year of greater than 5% GDP growth real GDP growth

results.summary: High bandwidth memory (HBM) producers are the best performing asset of 2025 due to persistent compute scarcity
results.quote: high bandwidth memory is a bigger part of in cogs on gpus than Taiwan Semi
results.evidence: The host directly addresses 'Gavin what would be the best performing asset of 2025' and the HBM answer immediately follows, with Baker self-identifying via fund-CIO framing about HBM in GPU COGS.

results.summary: Inference compute and test-time compute will cause a second GPU/accelerator shortage in 2025 analogous to 2023
results.quote: we are going to run out of gpus accelerators compute in 2025 the same way we did in 23
results.evidence: The quote about running out of GPUs/accelerators in 2025 appears in Baker's extended remarks during the best-performing-asset segment after being directly called on by the host.

results.summary: Enterprise application software (SaaS) will be the worst performing asset class of 2025 as AI agents displace them
results.quote: enterprise application software I think is going to be in a lot of pain
results.evidence: Host says 'worst performing asset of 2025 Gavin' and Baker's answer about enterprise application software immediately follows, confirmed by Chamath then saying 'I think Gavin just absolutely nailed it.'

results.summary: Frontier AI labs will stop releasing leading-edge models publicly to prevent knowledge distillation and IP theft
results.quote: frontier labs stop releasing their leading edge models to prevent knowledge distillation
results.evidence: The turn begins with Baker responding to Chamath's contrarian take, self-identifies with 'my most cont belief' and 'as far as a specific prediction for 25,' and Freeberg's turn follows after Baker's remarks.

results.summary: Government service providers / federal contractors are the biggest business losers of 2025 due to DOGE scrutiny
results.quote: you do not want to have the United States government at any level is over 35% of your revenue
results.evidence: Host directly asks 'biggest business loser for 2025 what's your prediction Gavin Baker' and the government service providers answer immediately follows.

results.summary: Traditional auto OEMs are uninvestable and will be forced into mega-mergers as Tesla and Chinese EVs dominate
results.quote: they're going to lose their Chinese business because they don't make competitive products anymore
results.evidence: Host asks 'Gavin you got a spread trade are you short these names' and Baker responds agreeing with Chamath and adding 'they're going to lose their Chinese business,' confirming Baker as speaker.

results.summary: The full-stack AI provider (owning compute + model) will be the ultimate AI winner; renting compute is a structural disadvantage
results.quote: the ultimate AI winner will be the one with the lowest cost of infrastructure
results.evidence: Host asks 'Gavin what do you think to be the biggest business deal in 2025' and Baker's M&A/Intel/full-stack AI answer follows, ending with 'the ultimate AI winner will be the one with the lowest cost of infrastructure.'

results.summary: AI will make more progress per quarter in 2025 than it did per year in 2023-2024 due to three multiplicative scaling axes
results.quote: AI is going to make more progress per quarter in 2025 than it did per year in 23 and 24
results.evidence: Host says 'Gavin what do you got' for most anticipated 2025 trend and Baker's answer about AI making more progress per quarter immediately follows, with self-referential 'I sent you a chart.'

results.summary: FSD is crossing into mainstream adoption and Tesla's autonomous driving will compound at an accelerating rate in 2025
results.quote: FSD works today and it's going to cross into mainstream adoption
results.evidence: The transcript window is the show intro with no speaker markers near the FSD quote; cannot determine who spoke it from this window.

results.summary: M&A wave is coming after four years of regulatory suppression; Intel will be subject to a significant deal
results.quote: something will happen with Intel and that will be big and hopefully it's good for America
results.evidence: Host asks 'Gavin what do you think to be the biggest business deal in 2025' and Baker's answer about M&A wave and Intel immediately follows in the same turn.

results.summary: AI will amplify economic inequality significantly in the near term before potentially democratizing opportunity
results.quote: AI is going to really amplify inequality for some period of time
results.evidence: The quote 'AI is going to really amplify inequality for some period of time' follows Freeberg's socialist-movements prediction with Baker adding 'I totally agree I think AI…' in a turn that uses CIO-register framing about test-time compute advantage.

results.summary: Zipline autonomous drones are a compelling investment in last-mile delivery for suburban America
results.quote: autonomous drones they really are the best way to deliver almost anything to suburban America
results.evidence: Baker says 'there's a company called zipline which my firm is an investor in' immediately before the autonomous drones quote, confirming Baker as speaker via self-identification of fund investment.
